evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, cmd_measure already creates a separate `measured` list, appends only items for which `apply_measure(i)` ran, and sorts `measured`. The skipped followup item without a `measure` is skipped before `apply_measure` and excluded from ranking, so the alleged `KeyError` on `i["measure"]` no longer occurs. The fix is present in the supplied history as commit 4cbc5392146d1e78678fcb0bf7f1379dad1252df.
